We Also Serve

The Galleria – Houston, TX

Briargrove Eye Center is located near the Galleria Mall and serves residents who live in the surrounding area. The Galleria is an upscale shopping center in Houston, TX. The complex has a retail section, but also a contains the Galleria Office Towers, the Westin hotels, and a private health club.
